convert_vissl_model_to_torchvision: convert a VISSL ResNe(X)ts model checkpoint to Torchvision-compatible format using CLI
run_convert_and_save_model: run convert_and_save_model to load a VISSL checkpoint and save converted state dict to output directory
load_vissl_checkpoint_from_url: load a VISSL model state dict from a URL or local file path for conversion
replace_module_prefix_keys: replace _feature_blocks. prefix in VISSL model keys to match Torchvision naming convention
parse_cli_arguments: parse CLI arguments for model URL, output directory, and output name for model conversion
